# FMC Media PC 0.2.9

- Anime lists show each series once: later seasons fold into their first season (Attack on Titan, My Hero Academia, Haikyu and others), while films and separate series keep their own cards.
- Opening an anime season such as "Attack on Titan Season 3" shows the whole series on that season, without duplicated episodes.
- Anime films such as Your Name. are shown as movies with a Play button instead of a one-episode list.
- Upcoming episodes show their air date and a countdown instead of a broken image.
- Anime browsing no longer repeats a page while scrolling.

Update from Settings → About → Check for updates. Activation, library and watch progress are preserved. Windows x64.
